cooking: 60 minutes|difficulty=3|image=[[File:Spare ribs with Chinese barbecue sauce cropped.jpg|300px]]}} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Barbecue|Barbecue]] | [[Cookbook:Meat and Poultry|Meat]] '''Barbecued Spare Ribs''' are a classic [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American]] barbecue meal made from pork. This version is cooked in the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]], not on a barbecue, and uses a [[Cookbook:Barbecue Sauce|barbecue sauce]] with [[Cookbook:East Asian cuisines|Asian]]-associated flavors like soy sauce, rice vinegar, and garlic. ==Ingredients== *2 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] (910 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] spare ribs *¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (60 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]] *2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]] *2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Hoisin Sauce|hoisin sauce]] *2 tablespoons white [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]] *1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Sake|sake]] *2 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]] *1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] *¼ teaspoon of freshly ground white [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]] *2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Stock|pork stock]] * Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]] and [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] to taste *2 teaspoons [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]] (optional) ==Procedure== #Place spare ribs in a large [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]] in one layer. In a small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients. Pour over spare ribs and coat on both sides. [[Cookbook:Marinating|Marinate]] overnight, [[Cookbook:Basting|basting]] occasionally. #Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|{{convert|375|F|C}}]]. Place a large, shallow roasting pan on the oven bottom. Fill with {{convert|0.5|in|cm}} water. Place spare ribs on a roasting rack. #[[Cookbook:Roasting|Roast]] ribs for 45 minutes. #Raise oven temperature to [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|{{convert|450|F|C}}]], and roast for 15 more minutes. #Serve hot or cold. ==Notes, tips, and variations== *Alternatively, bake at [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|{{convert|375|F|C}}]] for 20 mins then lower the temp to [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|{{convert|325|F|C}}]] for 1 hour; this [[Cookbook:Rendering|renders]] most of the fat and produces very tender meat. *To actually barbecue the ribs on a [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]], get grill temperature to {{convert|225|F|C}} and cook for 5-6 hours.
